artworks.title: A Horse Bound to a Feeding Trough
artworks.description: The image depicts a horse next to a wooden trough. A structure with stairs is visible to the left. In the background, a field extends to the horizon where small figures are seen. The illustration features fine linear etching with cross-hatching, showcasing textures and details. The monochrome color palette consists of black, gray, and off-white shades, creating depth. Wispy clouds are lightly sketched in the sky.

artworks.title: A Seated Man with a Pack of Dogs
artworks.description: The image shows a group of dogs gathered around a seated figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The horizon is positioned low in the image, with a rider on horseback and another figure pointing in the distance. The scene is depicted using fine lines and a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: A Standing Youth Gesturing to His Right
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I, after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks in deep purple, light brown, and pink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic pose, with one arm extended upward and the other arm holding onto a draped piece of fabric. The individual's body is angled slightly to the side, standing on one leg with the other bent at the knee. The facial features are softly defined with a serene expression, and the hair appears wavy. The person is unclothed, with the fabric strategically covering parts of the body. The background has a monochrome color scheme with a decorative pattern on the right side. There are no prominent jewelry pieces or objects, and the setting suggests a stylized, artistic representation without a defined three-dimensional background.

artworks.title: A Standing Youth Gesturing to His Right
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I, after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut, printed in three blocks in two shades of gray-green and ochre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nude figure draped with a flowing cloth. The figure is standing on a small patch of ground, with one hand raised and touching a piece of cloth above. The artwork is rendered in monochromatic blue tones, with soft shadows and highlights accentuating the musculature and form of the figure. The background is minimal, focusing attention on the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on the ground, facing away, leaning on his right hand, and holding a large book in his left hand. He has short, curly hair and is bare-chested, wearing a cloth around his lower body. In front of him are two books and a human skull. The background includes a gnarled tree and foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Gabriele D'Annunzio
artworks.medium: etching with monotone wiping, printed in dark brown on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body in a seated or reclining position, turned slightly to the side. One hand is brought up to their chin in a contemplative manner. The face is detailed with a focused gaze and prominent features. The individual has short hair covered by a draped fabric forming a hood around their head. They wear a robe or cloak that matches the head covering. The background consists of swirling, crosshatched lines creating depth and texture, with no distinct objects or scenery visible.

artworks.title: A Perspective of Seven Stars Balanced on Three Crosses
artworks.description: The image displays geometric shapes such as stars, crosses, and rings. There is a collection of interconnected star-like forms at the top and three crosses rising from circular bases below. The composition conveys balance with a structured design resembling familiar objects like Christmas ornaments and architectural motifs.

artworks.title: A Perspective of a Faceted Snail Shell Balanced on a Pyramid
artworks.description: The image displays a complex design of curved lines intersecting to form a spiral structure with a pointed star at the top. It resembles a futuristic dome with geometric patterns similar to a honeycomb or segmented armor. The structure sits on a base resembling a three-dimensional pyramid, giving it the appearance of a surreal architectural model.

artworks.title: Fragment of a Lion Bas-Relief (verso)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular animal in motion. The drawing is executed with a red chalk technique that captures the lines and contours of the animal, with attention to its shoulders and torso. The image features shading and line work to suggest the form and muscle structure of the animal, giving it a sense of depth and volume. The strokes are delicate yet decisive, evoking a sense of movement. The background remains unadorned, focusing the viewer's attention on the animal.

artworks.title: The Brigade de Shoe Black, City Hall Park
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a wall covered with posters. The image shows a wall entirely plastered with various posters and advertisements. The posters advertise theatrical performances, concerts, and other events, with many boasting striking typography and bold text. Some notable features include mentions of performances like "Tom Thumb," "Wives of Paris," and "Kenneth." The wall creates a textured backdrop, with a pathway in front where several men stand casually. The scene emphasizes the vibrant and bustling nature of street advertising from the time period and provides insight into the popular entertainment and culture of that era.

artworks.title: The Lone Lagoon
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a minimalist view with two clusters of dense vegetation in the center reflected on still water. The horizon is near the middle, blending with the sky and water. Soft brushstrokes or a photographic effect create gentle transitions between shades of gray. The color palette is grayscale, offering a tranquil experience. Distant elements have hazy outlines, enhancing the dreamlike quality.

artworks.title: Gnarled Thorn Trees
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sparse grove of bare trees in a flat, snowy landscape. The horizon line is above the trees, with a vast, overcast sky filling the upper two-thirds of the composition. The trees are arranged in a gentle curve, with dark branches contrasting against the pale snow. The color palette is muted grayscale, giving the scene an ethereal quality. The fine detail and shading suggest a meticulous technique, enhancing the tranquil and isolated ambiance of the setting.

artworks.title: A View in Subiaco
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a set of stone steps leading towards a darkened archway. The perspective is from below, emphasizing the narrowness and steep incline of the passage. A house with a window is visible above the archway, with a patch of blue sky and leafy branches above rooftops in the background. The painting uses loose, fluid brushstrokes to depict the stone walls and steps with earthy browns, grays, and hints of warm orange tones. The color palette is dominated by muted earth tones, with a vivid azure sky adding contrast. The watercolor technique adds warmth and age to the rustic stone surroundings.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint Anne and Two Angels
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Hans von Aachen
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures with their upper bodies close together. In the center, a woman is seated with a child on her lap. To the left, an older man and another figure lean in towards the child. On the right, a young figure holds flowers, with fruits displayed nearby. The background is textured and dark.

artworks.title: Telemachus Requests Permission from Pluto to Seek His Father in the Underworld
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over graphite on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows five figures portrayed from head to toe. The person on the far left wears ornate armor and a plumed helmet, holding a spear in their left hand and gesturing with their right hand. The second figure from the left is seated, dressed in a flowing gown with a sash, calmly looking towards the seated figure on their right, with their left hand resting on their companion's arm. The central figure is a bearded man with long hair, sitting with legs apart, muscular, bare-chested, draped with cloth below the waist, and holding a long staff or trident in his right hand. Two additional figures are between the seated figures, with one leaning back near the center, and another crouched over with their face obscured by their arms. The background features a rocky setting, resembling a cave-like atmosphere, with a distant scene on the left showing smoke or fire near a settlement by water.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist as an Infant
artworks.medium: black, red and white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a young child seated on a draped surface. The child is sitting with one leg crossed over the other, holding a long thin staff with a ribbon wrapped around it. Beside the child is a sheep. The background is a simple, textured surface with sketch-like shading.

artworks.title: A Lakeside Chapel by Moonlight
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime scene viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is not visible, with hills rising behind a small building on the left. A cross stands among trees, illuminated by moonlight. The artwork has detailed brushstrokes, creating a textured effect in black and gray tones. The moon is partially obscured by clouds, casting a faint light on the landscape.

artworks.title: A Forest Clearing
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene with tall trees and dense foliage forming a canopy. The etching style depicts detailed textures of tree bark and leaves in varying shades of gray. The ground is depicted with fine strokes, suggesting lush undergrowth, while trees in the distance fade into a densely packed composition, creating an expansive forest setting.

artworks.title: Dog Asleep Beside a Pair of Boots
artworks.description: The image shows a sleeping dog, an overturned boot, an upright boot, and a pestle and mortar set on a monochromatic background with shades of black and white. The dog is curled up on a piece of fabric, with the boots and the pestle and mortar nearby.

artworks.title: Beaulne (Beaune)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and blue wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a town labeled as "Beaulne" from a slightly elevated perspective. Various buildings in the town are named, such as "Castel," "S. Denis," and "S. Pacidianeas." The horizon is high, showcasing the town's structures against hills in the background. The artwork features light, sketch-like brushstrokes with muted colors of soft browns and grays. Vegetated patches are visible nearby, and a river flows past the town. The landscape gradually rises into hills in the distance, complementing the historical architecture. The color scheme is subdued and monochromatic.

artworks.title: Dawn in the Valley
artworks.medium: watercolor with scratching out and gum arabic on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a landscape with rolling green hills and valleys viewed from an elevated vantage point. The horizon line is high in the painting, and in the blue sky above it the sun is breaking through gray clouds, casting pale yellow beams of light on the distant, hazy hills. Closer to us, on the left, a flock of white sheep grazes on a grassy slope with trees. The far-left edge of the painting is framed by a tall tree. On the right, a distant person can be seen walking alongside three cows. A river runs through the scene, and between the fields and trees, small gray buildings can be seen, as well as a few plumes of gray smoke. The color palette of the landscape mainly consists of greens and dark blues.

artworks.title: Lula Lake, Lookout Mountain, Georgia
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing into a pool of water surrounded by rocks and trees. A person is standing near a rock in the foreground. The waterfall is centered in the image, with its reflection visible in the pool. The rocks and trees frame the scene, and the horizon is not visible. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned, highlighting the textures of the rocks and water. The lighting adds to the serene atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Lula Lake, Upper Falls, Lookout Mountain, Georgia
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading down into a calm pool of water surrounded by rocky cliffs and trees. The horizon is not prominently visible. The water appears smooth due to long-exposure techniques. The color palette is sepia, giving a vintage feel. Large rocks and sparse vegetation are in the foreground, while tall trees with icicles are in the background.

artworks.title: A Fountain with Three Nereids
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on beige paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical fountain with sculptural figures. The image depicts a towering fountain with multiple basins. At the base of the fountain, there are intricate figurative sculptures of mythical or allegorical figures in fluid poses, entwined with elements resembling water or decorative motifs. The drawing outlines the contours and shadows with subtle lines and shading, giving the impression of depth and texture. The background includes sketchy representations of clouds or foliage.
